caption: An observer watches the bottom cane block: it fires at every growth step and when the cane grows. Its pulse reaches the piston through a stone and the dust on it; the piston head breaks the cane's second block and shoves the item into a hopper minecart, which takes every item at once (a hopper waits 8 gt after each item it takes), and the hopper under its rail empties it into the chest. Water: a waterlogged waxed copper grate beside the soil. Copies stand side by side, 5 blocks apart.
